caption: The drawing depicts three carved wooden human-like figures shown side by side against an off-white background. The figure on the far left is viewed in profile, showing a curved back and three dark circular spots along its torso. It has a simple, rounded head with indistinct facial features and arms carved close to its body. The middle figure is shown from the front, with a rectangular overall shape, a flat top to the head, and a face marked by two round, dark eyes, a horizontal red mouth, and faint lines suggesting a nose; the hands and arms are not distinctly separated from the body. The figure on the right is also shown from the front, but it is partially covered by a textured, grayish-brown cloak or blanket that wraps over its head and body, secured by a small red detail at the neck; its face, visible through the covering, resembles that of the middle figure, with similar dark eyes and a red mouth. The wood of the figures is depicted with light brown, medium brown, and reddish-brown hues, indicating grain and carved details. The artist's signature "Beverly Chichester" appears in the lower right section of the drawing.
title: Wooden Doll
